title: Agent 应用开发工程师（AI 社交方向）
jd_text:
任职要求：

1、计算机、软件工程、人工智能或相关专业本科及以上学历；具备3年及以上服务端开发经验，有大模型、Agent或智能对话产品开发经验者优先。

2、具备扎实的软件工程基础，熟练使用 Go 进行高性能后端开发，掌握并发编程、网络服务和性能调优；熟悉 Python 及 FastAPI、异步编程等开发生态，能够独立开发 Agent 服务、模型调用及数据处理程序。

3、熟悉 MySQL、Redis、MongoDB、Kafka 等常用存储、缓存和消息中间件，具备合理选型、数据建模和性能优化能力。

4、熟悉 LLM Agent 的核心机制，理解任务规划、Tool/Function Calling、状态管理、上下文管理、长短期记忆及多智能体协作等能力。

熟悉 RAG 全流程，理解文档处理、Embedding、向量检索、混合召回和 Rerank 等关键环节；使用过主流向量数据库或检索引擎。

5、具备 Harness/Loop Engineering 实践经验，能够围绕 Agent 执行轨迹搭建运行、调试、评测和反馈闭环，提升复杂任务的成功率与可控性。

6、具备分布式系统设计能力，有高并发、低延迟或大规模在线服务开发经验，关注系统稳定性、可观测性、资源效率和故障恢复能力。

7、具备良好的数据意识，能够通过日志和用户行为数据定位体验问题，设计效果指标和 A/B 实验，并推动模型、Prompt或业务策略迭代。

对 AI 社交、虚拟角色或互动娱乐产品有浓厚兴趣，具备良好的产品理解、跨团队协作和快速学习能力，能够持续跟进大模型及 Agent 技术发展。

加分项：

1、有 AI 陪伴、社交、游戏、社区、UGC或智能客服等多轮互动产品的实际开发经验。

2、有 LangGraph、OpenAI Agents SDK、LangChain、AutoGen 等 Agent 框架的生产实践，或具备自研 Agent Runtime、Tool/Skill、MCP 服务的经验。

3、有 Agent 自动化评测、轨迹回放、Bad Case平台、模型网关或多模型路由系统建设经验。

4、熟悉大模型推理部署与性能优化，包括 vLLM、SGLang、模型量化、推理加速或 GPU 资源调度。

5、有 SFT、LoRA、偏好数据构建或模型效果评测经验。

6、有 ASR、TTS、语音对话、图像生成、视觉理解等多模态能力的接入和产品化经验。

7、有内容安全、隐私保护、风控策略或生成式 AI 安全治理经验。

【岗位亮点】Why Us?
-欢迎加入趣丸科技——集兴趣社交、人工智能、电子竞技等业务于一体的创新型科技企业。
-我们七次入选中国互联网综合实力百强企业， 2025年新晋成为胡润全球独角兽企业。这里汇聚了众多顶尖人才，其中研发人员占比超62%，近五年研发投入超19亿元，这里不仅是技术创新的热土，更是梦想绽放的舞台。

What We Do & Impact
人工智能：
-已构建全栈式AI交互技术产业生态，在AI语音、AI音乐、数字人、三维生成等领域均有自研模型与落地应用。语音大模型“MaskGCT”、3D生成大模型“Kiss3DGen”等自研模型刷新多项SOTA，获得国际顶会认可。一站式AI语音创作平台趣丸千音（All Voice Lab）集成文本转语音、视频翻译、多语种合成等多元能力，是业界首个从模型到应用全面赶超国际先进水平的AI语音产品。天谱乐AI稳居中国AI音乐第一梯队，歌声自然度突破音乐“图灵测试“，效果超越美国头部模型！
兴趣社交：
-作为国内领先的兴趣社交平台，TT语音为2亿玩家提供组队开黑、队友匹配、电子竞技等多种娱乐互动服务，同时也是五大全球顶级职业赛事官方合作伙伴。还有唱鸭、Uki等，Z世代年轻人在此结识兴趣同好，在认同中汲取前行力量！
电子竞技：
-2019年TT电竞成立，现拥有英雄联盟分部、王者荣耀分部、英雄联盟手游分部及和平精英分部，是广州首家实现双战队地域冠名以及华南区唯一拥有四大顶级电竞职业联赛席位的俱乐部。我们在电竞场上书写荣耀，点燃热血青春，以冠军之名，粤上巅峰！

What You Gain
竞争力回报&福利：
-有行业竞争力的月薪 + 年终奖金
-免费一日三餐 + 下午茶
-六险一金 + 年度健康体检 + 年度2000旅游 + 带薪年假 + 打车报销/优惠
新人landing体系&超速成长通道：
-新人landing体系 & 1V1领航员助力融入~
-清晰的职业发展双通道（专家/管理），尊重人才的氛围导向~
-针对不同人群的学习赋能项目，资源满满，助力起飞！
打造有温度的工作氛围&丰富的员工关怀体系：
-每年举办周年庆、年会等大型活动，同享发展！
-入职即享“新人大礼包”，节日更有专属员工礼盒+家属礼盒双份心意，把温暖带回家~
-兴趣社团自由生长——大玩家Club，提供专项赞助鼓励大家组“搭子”、发展兴趣爱好！
-部门团建，还有各类节日主题活动，工作之余也可以很有趣！
-健身房、理疗室，还有艺术课程、瑜伽、普拉提课程，关爱身心健康~

title: 智能体算法专家（J104318）
jd_text:
-负责通用智能体核心算法的设计与优化，建设从任务理解、规划决策、工具执行、结果验证到最终交付的完整任务执行能力
-负责用户意图与任务目标理解、多步骤任务拆解、动态规划和执行过程中的下一步决策，提升复杂长程任务的完成效果
-建设 Tool / Skill 的召回、选择、路由和参数生成能力，优化大规模工具接入后的候选选择、上下文组织和调用准确率
-建设智能体上下文与状态管理能力，包括任务状态、工作记忆、历史信息选择、上下文压缩、Checkpoint 和跨轮任务恢复
-建设基于 Agent Trace 的评测与问题归因体系，分析任务理解、规划决策、工具选择、参数生成、工具执行、上下文状态和结果交付等环节的问题
-围绕任务成功率、工具调用准确率、执行步骤数、Token 消耗、响应延迟和线上用户反馈，建立离线与在线评测闭环
-研究并落地 Critic、Verifier、Reflection、Risk Gate、模型路由和多模型协同等机制，提升复杂任务执行的可靠性与效率
-将智能体执行中的失败轨迹转化为评测样本、训练数据和优化方案，并与模型算法、搜索、文档处理、前后端和基础架构团队协作推动线上落地
-计算机、人工智能、软件工程、自动化等相关专业硕士及以上学历
-具备 3 年以上机器学习、自然语言处理、智能体或相关算法研发经验
-熟悉大语言模型和智能体基本原理，对 ReAct、Planning、Tool Use、Memory、Reflection、RAG 等机制有系统理解
-实际参与过至少一个具备多步骤任务执行、工具调用或长程状态管理能力的智能体项目，并能够说明核心技术方案与效果指标
-能够系统分析复杂任务中的模型理解、规划决策、工具调用、上下文状态和执行结果问题，并提出相应的算法优化方案
-熟练使用 Python，具备良好的算法工程能力，能够独立完成算法原型、线上研发、实验分析和问题排查
-熟悉模型评测和实验设计方法，能够根据 Agent Trace 建设错误分类、评测数据和迭代闭环
-具备较强的系统思维、自驱力和跨团队协作能力，能够独立负责一个智能体核心方向并推动落地
-加分项
-有办公智能体、内容创作智能体、Browser Agent、Coding Agent、Deep Research、AI 搜索或数据分析智能体相关经验
-有大规模 Tool / Skill 管理、动态工具召回、能力路由或模型路由经验
-有智能体评测、Trajectory Analysis、自动归因、Critic、Verifier 或 Risk Gate 相关经验
-有上下文管理、长期记忆、任务状态、Checkpoint、任务恢复或长程任务系统经验
-熟悉 AgentScope、LangGraph、OpenAI Agents SDK、AutoGen 等智能体开发框架
-有 Agentic RL、Tool-use Training、Trajectory Data、Process Reward 或智能体后训练经验
-有分布式任务调度、状态机、Redis、消息队列、沙箱执行或高并发系统相关经验
-在大模型、智能体或自然语言处理相关会议发表过论文，或有高质量开源项目贡献

jd_text:
团队介绍
腾讯游戏商务部的主旨是建立腾讯与全球优质厂商的桥梁，服务与全球100+投资伙伴和重要厂商。持续扩大腾讯在全球互联网生态和游戏行业的影响力，利用敏锐的嗅觉捕捉高潜力商业合作机会，并帮助投资伙伴持续的成长。深耕亚太、欧美和新兴市场，与日本、韩国、美国、英国、法国、芬兰、德国等成熟市场和东南亚、中东、土耳其等新区域的伙伴建立了深度的战略合作关系，实现商业上的共赢。
商务部期待全球的优秀人才一同加入，通过全球的优质人才网络巩固和扩大腾讯与全球合作伙伴的合作关系，并为市场孵化更多优质的游戏产品。

岗位职责
1.负责部门 Agent 产品研发，与业务、Agent 产品及运营团队紧密合作，将业务需求转化为可实现、可验证、可量化的技术方案，承担架构设计、前后端开发、测试、部署及持续迭代的完整闭环。2.负责 Agent 核心能力建设，包括企业知识库、RAG、记忆系统、工具调用、业务 Agent、MCP，以及 Multi-Agent 与人机协作流程的设计和实施。
3.负责 Agent 与腾讯内部基础设施及产品的集成，包括模型与 Agent 平台、权限身份体系、知识库及数据平台，并通过 API、SDK、MCP等方式建设稳定、可复用的连接能力。
4.建设部门 Agent Benchmark、评测与可观测体系，通过自动化评测、回归测试、Tracing、日志监控和反馈闭环，持续优化任务成功率、生成质量、稳定性、响应速度及成本。
5.建设生产级工程与安全保障体系，包括 CI/CD、自动化测试、灰度发布、故障恢复、权限控制、操作审计和数据隔离，保障 Agent 产品安全稳定运行。

岗位要求
1.本科及以上学历，5 年以上软件研发经验，具备复杂系统或产品从0到1交付经验；能力和作品突出者可适当放宽。2.熟练掌握 JavaScript/TypeScript，熟悉 React 或 Vue 中至少一种主流前端框架。熟练使用 Python、Go、Java或基于 Node.js 的服务端开发技术，熟悉 API、数据库、缓存及异步任务，具备独立全栈交付能力。3.理解 Agent Loop、Memory、Tool Calling、RAG、MCP、Planning及 Multi-Agent 等技术，并具备实际 Agent 项目开发或生产落地经验。4.具备良好的工程、产品和跨团队协作能力，重视代码质量、测试、可观测性、安全性及上线结果，能够熟练使用 AI Coding 工具提升研发效率。加分项
生产级 Agent、开发者工具或企业知识助手的落地经验。
企业知识图谱、agent/LLM评测或反馈数据闭环经验。
企业数据库系统建设，多来源数据库治理经验。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

在AI音乐领域，趣丸科技率先完成从模型、应用至硬件的全链布局。

在数字人领域，趣丸科技为十五运会和残特奥会量身打造的“数字人志愿者”系统，依托 “全运广州” 小程序与场馆智能一体机，可以为运动员、观众、志愿者等群体提供全天候、多场景的精准服务。该系统使人力成本降低30%，响应效率提升50%，让赛事参与体验更高效便捷。赛后这套数字人系统将转化为广州的“数字城市资产”，向文旅、会展、政务等场景持续渗透。

在三维生成领域，趣丸万相作为趣丸科技旗下三维生成品牌，专注AI三维生成与全彩打印一体化解决方案，即消费者仅需用一张“2D照片”就能定制工业级品质的“全彩3D实物”。业务深耕人物、宠物、潮玩等消费场景，服务客户遍及日本、韩国、俄罗斯、美洲、澳洲等国家和地区。

此外，公司加快高水平人才建设，与香港中文大学（深圳）、香港科技大学（广州）等顶尖高校共建人工智能联合实验室，形成“双核驱动”格局，为产业高质量发展提供全球化视野和动能源泉。

title: 光子艺术部-Agent 研发工程师
jd_text:
1.负责面向创作场景的多轮 Agent 系统研发与线上演进，覆盖编排运行时、上下文工程、工具体系等核心链路，保障长程任务可中断、可恢复、可追溯；
2.独立设计并落地 Agent 执行流程：多步任务拆解与推进、子 Agent 调度、任务挂起与恢复、人在环确认，以及超时、部分失败、重复调用的兜底策略；
3.负责上下文分层组织与预算分配，设计历史裁剪 / 压缩、会话摘要、缓存友好的 prompt 结构，以及多模态内容接入方案；
4.建设工具体系：接口与错误语义、工具网关、调用幂等与重试、产物校验与出站管控，对齐 Function Calling / MCP 等外部协议；
5.建设效果评测与可观测闭环：评测用例与回归门禁、全链路追踪与分段埋点、成本归因与延迟拆解，用数据驱动效果与成本优化；
6.与产品、前端、客户端协同，将模糊需求收敛为可验收的接口契约与跨端协议，保障同一套 Agent 能力在 Web 与桌面端一致交付。

总结 AI Coding 使用规范、最佳实践、培训材料和推广方法。
推动 AI Coding 从单点工具使用走向团队级、组织级研发模式升级。

jd_text:
1.两年以内互联网/AI产品经验，有 AI Agent、智能体、AI Native 产品实际落地经验优先。

4.具备 Agent 产品设计能力，能够将复杂业务任务拆解为 Agent 可理解、可规划、可执行的任务流程，并设计相应的 Tool、Skill、Workflow 和人机协作机制。
5.具备数据驱动的产品迭代能力，能够通过线上运行数据、用户行为、任务成功率、失败案例和用户反馈发现问题，并形成“发现问题 → 定位原因 → 优化 → 评测 → 上线”的持续迭代闭环。
6.具备较强的技术理解能力，能够与算法、后端、前端及数据团队进行深度协作，理解 Agent Runtime、模型调用、上下文管理、工具执行等技术机制；具备一定编程或技术实践能力优先。
7.具备较强的业务抽象能力和复杂问题解决能力，能够将金融交易等复杂业务场景抽象为可被 AI Agent 执行的任务、流程和能力。

理解业务 → 定义 Agent → 设计 Agent → 让 Agent 跑起来 → 观察真实运行 → 分析失败 → 持续优化 → 最终对 Agent 的业务价值负责。

jd_text:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
Focus on cutting-edge algorithm research and development in AI Coding Agents, fully automated game generation, and game world models, exploring key issues such as code generation, intelligent debugging, gameplay, and level generation. As a Coding Agent Researcher (Intern), you will participate in one or more of the following tasks:Develop LLM-based game coding agents to enable automatic code generation, game logic development, error diagnosis, automatic debugging, and iterative optimization.
Explore the use of AI to fully automate the generation of game demos, core gameplay, levels, and other procedural game content. Track cutting-edge directions such as Coding Agents, code large language models, and world models, and conduct algorithm experiments, paper reproduction, and technological innovation.
Drive the practical application of research outcomes in game development and interactive entertainment scenarios, and produce high-quality technical reports, papers, or patents.
Collaborate closely with senior researchers and game development teams to jointly explore AI-driven game development and virtual world construction technologies.

Who We Look For
Currently enrolled in a Master’s, or PhD program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field.
Familiar with Python, with solid programming skills and a strong foundation in deep learning; understand the basic principles of large language models and intelligent agents.
Capable of independently conducting experiments, debugging code, and optimizing models, and able to complete the full workflow from solution design to experimental validation.
Strong interest in game development, procedural content generation, and the application of generative AI in interactive entertainment. Good communication, collaboration, and technical presentation skills.
Preferred QualificationsFamiliarity with Unity, Unreal Engine, or other game engines; experience in developing Coding Agents, code large language models, tool use, or multi-agent systems is preferred.
Experience publishing relevant papers at top-tier conferences or journals such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS is preferred.

title: Agent Security Expert
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are building the next-generation Agent security product to protect enterprise AI workloads at scale. As our Agent Security Expert, you will define the technical architecture for real-time agent defense and lead the product's security roadmap in a fast-emerging global market. You will work at the intersection of application security, AI safety, and systems engineering, shaping how enterprises safely deploy autonomous agents across their digital infrastructure.Own the end-to-end technical architecture of our Agent security product, making principled trade-offs across detection coverage, latency, and operational overhead.
Design and implement runtime guardrails — including prompt injection defense, unauthorized tool-call interception, behavioral drift detection, and real-time credential leak prevention.
Architect MCP and tool-chain supply-chain security capabilities against tool poisoning, cross-origin privilege escalation, and transitive trust abuse.
Build an automated agent red-teaming pipeline to continuously discover vulnerabilities, generate adversarial test cases, and harden defenses before production deployment.
Partner with product, engineering, and threat intelligence teams to translate emerging attack patterns into shipped security features, and mentor junior engineers on security-first design.

Who We Look For
8+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, systems engineering, or a closely related field, with a track record of shipping production security components.
Deep expertise in at least two of: application security, cloud-native security, identity and access management (IAM), or offensive/defensive security operations.
Proficient in at least two of Go, Python, Rust, or C++, with experience building high-concurrency security services or detection pipelines.
Strong working knowledge of the LLM/Agent stack — RAG architectures, function calling, MCP protocol, and mainstream agent frameworks — and the unique attack surfaces they introduce.
Experience researching or shipping enterprise security products (EDR, CNAPP, AI-SPM, or equivalent); familiarity with sandboxing, eBPF, or container/virtualization isolation is a strong plus.

jd_text:

title: Tencent Cloud – Principal Engineer, Data+AI Infrastructure (Big Data Platform, Singapore)
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
About the Role
Tencent Cloud's Big Data team is hiring a Principal Engineer to help define data infrastructure for the AI era. We build data systems that power AI, and we are also bringing AI into the core of storage, compute, and operations, so that our infrastructure can optimize itself and run reliably with less manual effort.
 
Our work covers two areas. Infra for AI is about building data infrastructure that serves AI workloads. AI for Infra is about using AI to make that infrastructure smarter. At production scale, you will work on hard problems in data throughput, CPU/GPU utilization, and system reliability. You will help set technical direction and architecture, and take ideas from problem definition and research through prototyping to production. We value work that ships, and we also encourage open-source contributions and published research.
 
We welcome candidates with deep expertise in one or more of the following areas.
 
What You'll Do
1. Compute: Build distributed compute engines for data and AI workloads. Work on query and operator optimization, CPU/GPU scheduling, workload forecasting, and autoscaling. Help these systems move from static rules to adaptive tuning, and deliver better performance per unit of compute.
2. Storage: Remove data bottlenecks for AI. Design storage architectures for large-scale, multimodal, fast-changing data, covering tiering, hot/cold data detection, data layout, compression, caching, and I/O optimization. Deliver a fast, reliable, and cost-efficient data layer for model training, inference, and AI agents.
3. Data & Search: Combine LLMs, agents, and data systems to create new ways of working with data, such as natural-language queries, text-to-SQL, and automated analytics. Build multimodal data processing, data quality, and metadata capabilities that make enterprise data trustworthy, traceable, and ready for AI. Develop search capabilities, including query understanding, hybrid retrieval, embeddings and reranking, agentic search, and RAG.
4. Self-Managing Systems: Build closed-loop systems for monitoring, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and automated remediation. Solve hard problems in diagnostics, performance tuning, and capacity planning. Use safeguards such as rigorous evaluation, access controls, canary releases, and rollback so that automation stays safe.
5. Platform Architecture: Help design the next-generation cloud data platform for AI-native workloads, bringing storage, compute, retrieval, and model serving together. Own key modules or cross-module architecture, and make sound trade-offs across performance, reliability, openness, and cost.
6. Research to Production: Identify high-impact open problems across data infrastructure, AI infrastructure, and AI for infra. Apply ML, LLMs, agents, and reinforcement learning to real system problems, including RL reward modeling, policy optimization, and feedback learning. Train, fine-tune, and distill in-house models for data understanding, retrieval ranking, and system optimization. Take work from hypothesis to benchmarking to production, and share results through open source and top-tier conferences.

Who We Look For
1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field, with 5+ years of software engineering experience. You have strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and networking, and strong system design skills.
2. Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required as approximately 50% of the role involves collaborating with China headquarters on business discussions, meetings, and documentation
3. Expert in at least one of C++, Python, Java, Go, or Rust. You write high-quality, well-tested code and can debug complex systems.
4. Hands-on experience building storage, compute, database, data infrastructure, or AI infrastructure systems, with deep knowledge of at least one of these areas. Experience with distributed storage, query engines, database internals, data lakehouses, or resource scheduling is preferred.
5. Strong performance engineering skills. You can find bottlenecks across the full stack, from algorithms and models to compute, storage, networking, and scheduling, and you can prove improvements in performance, stability, and cost through profiling, benchmarking, and metrics.
6. Solid understanding of machine learning, LLMs, or AI agents. You can judge when AI is the right solution for a system problem, weighing accuracy, cost, and reliability, and you can take it from prototype to production.
7. A track record of leading architecture for large-scale core systems. You can set a long-term technical roadmap and phased delivery plan, run cross-team design reviews, lead complex technical work, and mentor engineers.
8. Strong ownership, independent problem-solving, and cross-team collaboration. You can break down ambiguous problems into clear, testable solutions and drive them into production.
 
Preferred Qualifications
1. Top-tier publications and research: Papers published or accepted at top conferences in databases, storage, systems, or AI, such as SIGMOD, VLDB, ICDE, FAST, SOSP, OSDI, NSDI, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or MLSys, with a clear account of your own contribution. Experience reproducing research, releasing open-source implementations, or turning research into engineering results is a plus.
2. AI for Infra experience: Hands-on projects that applied ML, LLMs, Agents, or reinforcement learning to query optimization, resource scheduling, storage optimization, performance tuning, AIOps, or data management, with measurable results.
3. Open-source and large-scale engineering: Contributions to relevant open-source projects, or leadership of key module development in ecosystems such as databases, Spark, or Ray. Production experience with GPU operators, inference engines, multimodal data pipelines, cloud-native multi-tenant systems, or serverless systems.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

title: 后训练算法专家（J104317）
jd_text:
-负责大模型在文档、搜索、创作、研究分析和复杂办公等场景中的算法研发与效果优化，重点提升指令理解、复杂推理与规划、工具调用、长上下文理解、事实性及结构化生成等能力
-建设大模型后训练数据体系，包括线上难例挖掘、任务轨迹分析、数据清洗、合成数据生成、偏好数据构造和数据质量评估
-根据实际任务选择并落地 SFT、DPO、RLHF、GRPO、蒸馏等后训练与行为对齐方案，提升模型在目标场景中的效果、稳定性和泛化能力
-建设模型评测体系，包括离线评测集、自动评估器、LLM-as-Judge、回归测试和线上实验，定位模型在理解、推理、工具调用和结果生成等环节的问题
-分析真实用户任务中的模型失败案例，将线上问题转化为可训练的数据、可量化的指标和可验证的实验方案，形成持续迭代闭环
-参与模型选型、大小模型协同、模型路由和推理策略优化，在任务效果、响应延迟与资源成本之间取得合理平衡
-与产品和工程团队协作，推动模型能力稳定应用于线上产品
-计算机、人工智能、数学、统计学、电子信息等相关专业硕士及以上学历
-具备 3 年以上大模型、自然语言处理、机器学习或相关方向研发经验
-熟悉 Transformer 和大语言模型基本原理，对预训练、指令微调、偏好对齐、强化学习和模型推理有系统理解
-具备大模型后训练、训练数据建设、模型评测或复杂业务场景模型优化经验，完整参与过至少一个从数据构建、训练实验到效果验证的大模型项目
-熟练使用 Python 和 PyTorch，具备良好的数据处理、模型训练、实验分析和问题定位能力
-能够将用户体验和业务效果问题转化为明确的模型问题、数据方案、评测指标和训练实验
-具备良好的工程意识，关注实验可复现性、数据版本管理、模型回归、线上稳定性和推理成本
-具备较强的自驱力、学习能力和结果意识，能够独立负责一个模型算法方向并推动落地

jd_text:
1.主导 Visual2Code 能力建设：负责多模态大语言模型在 Visual2Code 方向的核心算法研发，围绕“视觉输入—代码理解—代码生成—执行验证”完整链路，持续提升模型从界面、图表、文档、图像等视觉信息中理解结构并生成高质量代码的能力；
2.建设高质量数据体系：负责 Visual2Code 训练数据的设计、构建与迭代，包括真实数据挖掘、自动化数据合成、难度分层、质量过滤及数据配比等，建立覆盖多场景、多语言、多任务形态的数据生产与数据飞轮体系；
3.推进模型与算法创新：深入探索 Visual2Code 场景下的 SFT、强化学习、代码执行反馈、Verifier/Reward Model 等后训练方法，研究视觉理解、代码推理与执行反馈之间的协同机制，持续提升模型在复杂任务中的正确率、泛化能力与稳定性；
4.强化复杂视觉编程能力：聚焦视觉结构解析、布局理解、图表/文档理解、视觉逻辑推理以及代码生成等关键能力，提升模型从复杂视觉输入中完成结构还原、逻辑抽取、程序生成与迭代修正的能力；
5.建设系统化评测体系：搭建 Visual2Code 能力评测与诊断体系，从视觉感知、结构理解、代码正确性、执行结果、视觉还原度、复杂推理等维度建立 Benchmark 与自动化评测链路，持续定位模型能力瓶颈并指导训练迭代；

title: LLM Agent Research Intern 108250
jd_text:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are hiring a research intern to train LLM agents that play in-game characters. The agent has to stay in persona across multi-turn dialogue, use memory and game context, and keep relationship, tone, and world rules intact. The work sits on a live role-play NPC model: supervised fine-tuning today, with preference optimization and verifiable-reward reinforcement learning as the next training stages.1. Train role-play agents with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then post-train them with direct preference optimization (DPO) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Iterate on persona consistency, multi-turn coherence, and instruction following.
2. Build and curate SFT, preference, and verifiable-reward data for character dialogue, covering memory injection, relationship stage, language switching, emotion, and out-of-character resistance.
3. Design checks that can be verified automatically, such as format, language, persona boundaries, and safety refusals, and use them both as RLVR rewards and as offline regression tests.
4. Work with game designers and engineers to bring the agent into a live game, and keep latency, cost, and player experience within production constraints.

Who We Look For
1. Currently enrolled in a Master's or PhD program in Computer Science, NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, or recently graduated. Available at least three days per week, with supervisor and university approval where required.
2. Fluent English (written and spoken) and strong communication skills are required. You will work closely with game designers, engineers, and researchers across regions, and must be able to explain experiment results and trade-offs clearly.
3. Hands-on experience with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of LLMs, and with post-training methods including DPO and RLVR (or a closely related verifiable-reward RL method). You should be able to run the loop from data and training config through evaluation and the next iteration.
4. Experience training or evaluating role-play or character-dialogue models, including persona consistency, multi-turn dialogue, and staying in character.
5. Proficient in Python and PyTorch, and comfortable with the Hugging Face / Transformers training stack.
6. Preferred: experience with LLM agents (memory, planning, or tool use), LLM applications in games, or a publication at a major NLP/ML venue (ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML).

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

jd_text:
1.大模型工程架构与技术规划：负责大模型应用及相关工程体系的技术规划与架构设计，围绕模型训练、后训练、评测、Agent 及应用探索等方向，制定技术方案和演进路线。推动模型能力、工程框架和应用场景深度协同，建设可复用、可扩展的工程基础设施；
2.模型训练与后训练工程支持：与基模、应用算法及训练框架团队深度协作，支持模型训练、后训练、强化学习及评测等研发工作。围绕数据处理、训练任务编排、实验管理、模型调用、工具环境及自动化评测等环节，解决研发过程中的工程问题，提升模型实验效率、迭代速度和结果可复现性；
3.Agent Harness 与 Runtime 建设：主导 Agent 工程框架与运行环境建设，围绕 Context Engineering、Memory、Tool / Skill、Sandbox、任务编排、状态管理、Checkpoint、长任务执行与恢复等关键能力，构建稳定、高效、可扩展的 Agent Harness。支持 Personal Agent、Team Agent、Research Agent 等方向的模型能力研究、训练与应用验证；
4.AI 原生应用与端云协同探索：围绕 AI 对话、翻译、播客、多模态生成及 Agent 等场景，主导 AI 原生应用的技术架构与核心能力开发，支持 Web、移动端及桌面端等多种交付形态。探索端云协同、端侧模型推理、离线智能及多端 Context 共享，形成可复用的应用框架、组件和技术样板，推动模型能力在腾讯内外业务中落地；

6.技术领导力与团队建设：负责关键技术方向的架构决策和技术攻坚，推动算法、训练框架、平台、客户端及服务端团队高效协作。参与核心工程人才的招聘、培养和技术梯队建设，鼓励技术创新、开源及研究成果沉淀，打造兼具模型理解、工程深度和产品意识的研发团队。

title: Agent Harness 工程师
jd_text:
1.Agent Harness 核心框架研发：负责 Agent 运行时的架构设计与实现，包括 agent loop 调度、Tool/Skill 抽象与注册机制、Context 组装与压缩策略、长任务的状态持久化与 checkpoint 恢复、Sub-Agent 并发编排、以及沙箱隔离与权限控制体系，为上层业务提供稳定、可扩展、可复用的 Agent 执行底座；
2.全链路 Tracing 与 Observability：设计并实现 Agent 执行全链路的可观测系统，对 LLM 调用、工具调用、重试与降级、Token 与成本消耗、上下文膨胀等关键环节做 Span 级建模与结构化埋点；建设延迟/成本/成功率归因分析能力，沉淀 failure mode 分类体系与异常告警机制，让 Agent 的"黑盒行为"可解释、可回溯；
3.Agent 质量评估体系：构建自动化 eval pipeline，覆盖离线 Benchmark、在线 A/B Testing、SBS 人工评测与 regression detection；设计任务级评测指标与 rubric（含 LLM-as-Judge、pass@k、轨迹级评分），建设评测集管理与 CI 门禁，使每次 Prompt、模型、工具变更都有量化的收益与回归判定；
4.Agent Debugging 工具链：开发面向研发的调试工具，支持 Trace 回放与单步执行、上下文与 Prompt 的 Diff 对比、工具调用链可视化、失败样本最小复现集自动提取；打通从线上异常 Trace 到本地可复现调试的闭环，显著缩短 Agent 问题定位周期；
5.支撑平台建设与工程化落地：参与标注平台、数据管道、任务集与轨迹数据仓库等核心支撑平台的架构设计与开发，为模型训练与 Agent 迭代提供高质量数据闭环；与 AI 研究团队零距离协作，第一时间承接最新模型能力，将大模型与 Agent 协同进化的研究成果工程化落地，并持续探索 AI Agent 在日常研发工作流中的深度实践。

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
Responsibilities
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

jd_text:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1、AI Copilot 系统研发：负责本地化 AI Copilot 系统的架构设计与核心代码编写，实现 AI 辅助翻译、术语推荐、译后编辑（PE）等功能。
2、向量检索与 RAG 落地：负责向量数据库（Vector DB）的选型、搭建与优化；利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，将现有的翻译记忆库（TM）和术语库（TB）转化为向量，实现高召回、高精准的上下文检索。
3、主流大模型（LLM）接入与性能优化：负责将 Google Cloud（Vertex AI / Gemini）、OpenAI、Claude 等海外主流 AI 模型，通过 API 高效、稳定地接入公司现有的本地化作业平台与 CAT 自动化流水线；并解决大模型调用中的高并发、高延迟、API 限流等问题，优化 Token 消耗成本。
4、Prompt 工程与调优：主导面向多语种（特别是复杂语种，如韩语、泰语、缅甸语、西语等）的 Prompt 设计、微调与评估；通过 Few-shot、COT、Structured Output 等技术，确保 AI 翻译在字数限制、标签（Tag）保留、语气风格上达到工业级游戏本地化标准。
5、本地化 TMS 系统开发与运维：负责本地化 TMS 系统的新特性开发与已有功能的维护、性能优化，实现本地化流程自动化和全球应用。
6、本地化业务支持：理解游戏本地化流程与实践，利用 AI 与工具能力持续优化本地化效率与质量；后续可负责一到多款游戏的多语言本地化，与上游研发团队和发行团队沟通、制定整体本地化计划与预算、交付符合质量要求的本地化多语言版本。

岗位要求
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、语言类、本地化或相关专业，有3年以上实际开发经验。扎实的编程能力，熟练掌握 Python / Go / Node.js 中的至少一种开发语言，具备良好的编码规范。
2、大模型开发经验：熟悉 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等主流 LLM 开发框架，有实际的大模型 API（如 Google Vertex AI, OpenAI）对接与工程化落地经验。
3、向量数据库经验：熟悉至少一种向量数据库（如 Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma），理解向量嵌入（Embedding）原理，有 RAG 系统调优经验者优先；同事具备优秀的Prompt 能力，对 Prompt Engineering 有深入理解，能够熟练编写结构化 Prompt，并能通过自动评估或评测集不断迭代 Prompt 效果。
4、游戏本地化认知：了解游戏端内外内容的本地化流程和实践，有游戏本地化版本成功交付经验者优先；熟悉翻译、审校、 配音或LQA流程，对游戏本地化有独到的见解，善于利用工具和 AI 能力持续优化本地化效率和质量。
5、熟悉本地化业务：熟悉翻译记忆库（TMX）、术语表（TBX）、CAT 工具；具备MS office等本地化行业常见文档格式处理能力和经验者优先。
6、英语能力：书面或口头交流顺畅，能快速阅读英文技术文档，并与海外团队、供应商顺畅沟通。

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect (Singapore)
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position OverviewTencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across APAC. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud's AI portfolio, including TokenHub, Tencent Hy foundation models, leading third-party Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem, you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Sales teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will act as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, bringing customer feedback into product evolution while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides unified access to Tencent Hy and leading third-party LLMs through a single API, together with enterprise-grade inference, monitoring, deployment, and model management capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
ResponsibilitiesPartner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, Tencent Hy foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI services.
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing solution performance in production environments.
Design scalable AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, and cloud-native AI services.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, influence product roadmap decisions, and continuously improve developer experience through real-world customer feedback.
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate AI adoption across enterprise customers and partners.
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For
Job RequirementsBachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of AI model deployment, inference services, and production operations.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

4.推理架构演进：探索 PD 分离、投机解码、MoE 专家并行等前沿架构，优化长上下文、长思维链与高并发场景下的推理效率；

jd_text:

title: 大模型数据PDSA（J99381）
jd_text:
-负责面向大模型公司、科技公司、互联网公司等客户，销售高质量数据集及定制化的数据采集与标注服务，深入理解客户在大模型预训练、微调、对齐、评测等环节的数据需求，提供端到端的数据解决方案

-协同数据供应商与内部数据生产团队，确保销售的数据集与服务具备高质量、高合规性与稳定交付能力，针对客户对数据安全、版权、隐私合规的要求，提供合规保障方案

-具备扎实的人工智能与数据工程知识，深入了解大模型训练/微调/对齐对数据的需求（如预训练数据、SFT数据、RLHF数据、评测数据等），能够与客户算法、技术团队进行高效沟通，有大模型数据支撑项目销售或交付经验者优先
-拥有丰富的大模型公司、科技公司或互联网公司客户资源或拓展经验，熟悉至少一类客户（如大模型创业公司、头部科技企业AI部门、互联网公司算法团队）的组织架构与决策流程，能够快速切入客户数据需求
-具备独立完成从客户需求调研、方案设计、商务谈判、签约到交付验收的全流程销售能力，有数据集产品或定制化数据采集/标注服务的成功销售案例者优先
-熟悉数据采集、标注、质量控制、合规与交付流程，了解常见数据标注平台与工具，能够针对客户的精度要求（如99%+一致性）、数据安全（如私有化部署、数据隔离）等设计相应方案
-具备优秀的逻辑思维能力、问题解决能力与项目管理能力，能够高效推进跨部门协作，保障销售项目按时按质交付并完成回款
-热爱并持续关注大模型与AI行业动态，具备敏锐的市场洞察力与客户服务意识，沟通表达能力强，责任心强，能适应快速变化的客户需求与销售节奏

jd_text:

title: Agent社区产品经理
jd_text:
任职要求
- 必须有真实产品经理或产品负责人经验，有独立负责产品模块或0到1产品的经历；
- 能清楚讲明做过什么产品、服务什么用户、解决什么问题、如何设计方案以及最终结果；
- 具备完整产品能力：用户需求分析、产品定义、流程设计、原型设计、需求优先级、版本推进和迭代复盘；
- 必须具备Agent实践经验，实际创建、使用或管理过Agent；
- 有多Agent协作、Agent产品或AI产品相关经验优先；
- 能把抽象概念转化为具体产品机制，而不是停留在理念或方案层；
- 具备较强的0到1能力，能够在需求不清晰、没有成熟答案的情况下推进产品；
- 有独立判断，能够提出自己的产品假设，并通过Demo、数据和用户反馈验证；
- 熟悉Codex、Claude Code、Cursor等AI/Agent工具，并能用于真实产品工作；
- 能适应早期创业团队和较高不确定性，对最终产品结果负责。

加分项
- 做过Agent平台、Agent社区、多Agent系统或A2A相关产品；
- 有平台型、社区型、交易型或复杂规则型产品经验；
- 有身份、信用、权限、治理、经济系统等产品设计经验；
- 有Vibe Coding或AI辅助快速原型能力；
- 有真实上线产品、Demo、用户数据或完整产品案例。

以下情况暂不匹配
- 没有真实产品经验，只做过运营、项目管理或Agent使用；
- 只会写PRD，但没有独立负责产品从需求到上线的经历；
- 只懂Agent技术或工具，但缺少用户、场景和产品判断；
- 只会调用现成Agent，没有做过Agent产品或复杂协作设计；
- 依赖完整需求和成熟流程，无法独立定义产品；
- 有很多想法，但无法持续推进到Demo、上线和真实用户验证。

我们要找的不是“懂一点Agent的传统产品经理”，也不是“会用Agent的项目经理”。
我们希望你既有扎实的产品基本功，也真正理解Agent，并能进一步思考：
当Agent开始拥有身份、能力、信用和长期关系后，应该出现怎样的新产品、新交互和新社区形态？
你要做的，是把这些判断真正做成产品。

title: 大模型推理后台链路工程师（语音方向）（北京/深圳/上海）
jd_text:
1.推理后台链路建设：负责语音大模型推理后台链路的整体设计与实现，覆盖接入层、调度层、推理层、流式返回、落盘与全链路监控；
2.流式语音服务架构：构建实时语音对话（语音进—语音出）的流式推理服务，优化首字延迟（TTFB）、端到端延迟与实时率（RTF），保障交互流畅性；

4.分布式推理与弹性调度：建设多机多卡推理能力（张量并行 / 流水线并行）、多模型编排、弹性扩缩容、负载均衡与故障自愈机制；
5.稳定性与工程化：建设高可用架构、灰度发布、全链路监控告警、压测与容量规划，保障推理服务的稳定性与可观测性；
6.前沿技术落地：跟进语音大模型与推理框架的前沿进展，推动新技术在业务中的落地。

title: 推理优化工程师
jd_text:
二、任职能力要求
（一）必备能力
1. 专业背景：本科及以上学历，计算机、人工智能、软件工程、电子信息、数学等相关专业，1-3年大模型推理优化、AI算法工程落地相关工作经验。
2. 核心技术认知：精通大模型推理底层原理，熟练掌握TTFT、Token吞吐、KV Cache等核心推理指标的优化逻辑，深刻理解大模型自回归生成机制，具备模型推理优化落地的实战经验。
3. 技术栈能力：熟练使用Python、C++/CUDA编程，熟悉GPU推理加速原理；精通vLLM、sgLang、TensorRT等主流推理框架，能够独立完成框架适配、二次开发与性能调优。熟悉NVIDIA GPU底层架构、CUDA算子开发与优化，能够自主开发自定义推理算子。
4. 优化技术储备：熟练掌握量化、稀疏推理、投机解码、缓存优化、并行推理、动态Batch等主流推理优化技术，能够根据不同模型尺寸、业务场景制定最优优化方案。
5. 工程落地能力：具备完整的线上推理服务优化落地经验，能够独立完成问题排查、方案设计、实验验证、线上灰度与全量上线，熟悉GPU显存优化、算力调度、高并发服务调优。具备优秀的系统级性能分析能力，熟练使用Nsight Systems/Compute等工具进行瓶颈定位，能从算法、系统、硬件多维度提出解决方案。
6. 基础素养：具备良好的算法思维、数据敏感度，能够通过数据分析定位性能瓶颈；拥有较强的问题攻坚能力、自主学习能力，逻辑清晰，善于总结沉淀技术经验。
（二）优先加分项
1. 熟悉分布式推理、模型部署运维、云原生AI服务架构，有大规模线上推理集群调优经验者优先。
3. 跟踪业界前沿推理技术，有顶会论文阅读、复现及落地经验，或参与过开源推理框架贡献者优先。

title: Tencent Cloud – Senior Strategic Sales Executive, Public Sector (Generative AI & Cloud) – Singapore
jd_text:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.
Responsibilities
Identify, prospect, and develop strategic enterprise opportunities for Tencent Cloud’s AI and cloud solutions within the Singapore and SouthEast Asian market.
Build and manage executive-level relationships with customers, AI native companies, digital-native companies, ISVs, and enterprise organizations adopting Generative AI technologies.
Drive the sales of AI infrastructure, large language model (LLM) services, AI platforms, Model-as-a-Service (MaaS), API/token-based AI services, cloud infrastructure, and related SaaS offerings.
Lead the entire enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and solution positioning to commercial negotiations, contract execution, and successful deal closure.
Partner closely with Solution Architects, AI specialists, Product teams, and Business Contracts Managers to design customer-centric AI and cloud solutions.
Develop strategic account plans, pipeline forecasts, territory plans, and executive business reviews to consistently exceed revenue targets.
Understand customers’ AI transformation initiatives and recommend appropriate Tencent Cloud AI capabilities, including LLMs APIs, model hosting, AI agents, AI tools and AI development platforms.
Analyze industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging AI use cases to identify new business opportunities and develop go-to-market strategies.
Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams to maximize customer success, expansion opportunities, and long-term account growth.

Who We Look For
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of enterprise technology sales experience, with at least 2 years selling AI products, Generative AI platforms, LLM APIs, AI infrastructure, cloud services, GPU computing, ML platforms, SaaS, or developer platforms.
Demonstrated experience selling AI solutions such as LLM APIs, token-based AI services, inference platforms, AI agents, MLOps platforms, AI developer tools, or cloud AI infrastructure is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of the AI ecosystem, including Large Language Models (LLMs), foundation models, prompt engineering, AI inference, embeddings, AI agents, API consumption, and token-based commercial models.
Proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers (“hunter” mindset) while expanding strategic accounts and consistently exceeding sales targets.
Experience engaging C-level executives, technology leaders, AI teams, and business decision-makers, with a history of closing complex, high-value enterprise deals.
Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to translate complex AI and cloud technologies into measurable business outcomes.
Experience working with AI startups, digital-native companies, ISVs, SaaS vendors, or enterprise AI transformation projects is a strong advantage.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required as approximately 50% of the role involves collaborating with China headquarters on business discussions, meetings, and documentation.
Excellent analytical, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

有大型应用架构、稳定性或性能优化经验。
有 Kotlin Multiplatform 实际落地经验,或expo framework 开发经验/使用过expo framework。

我们希望你不被单一技术栈限制，不只是“等需求、写代码、提测”，而是能主动理解问题、提出方案并推动产品落地。
